audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was Azir-generic and the level chart disagreed between layers: content win[0..3]=Karma, win[4..6]=Azir, but full phases[0..4].side all read "Skill". The packet levelChart matches the content layer (Karma x4, Azir x3), and the 46.05% win rate over 1127 games supports Karma-favoured early.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range on a 9s cooldown falling to 5s; Azir places soldiers at 525 and his Q reaches 740. She controls the first four rows. Azir's Emperor's Divide at level 6 and Nashor's Tooth flip it.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Karma, phases[4].side -> Azir, with every why rewritten to match the new verdict and early ratings dropped to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text named "Shurima's Legacy" as the level 6 engage/disengage tool. Shurima's Legacy is Azir's passive (rebuilding a fallen turret as the Disc of the Sun); the level 6 tool is Emperor's Divide (R), 120/105/90s. breakdown.mid repeated the same error.
audit.why: ownerKit P text is the turret-rebuild passive; ownerKit R is the charging soldier wall with the terrain flag. The suspectNames entry flagged this exact string.
audit.corrected: Emperor's Divide on a 120s cooldown named as the level 6 spike in spikes[1].text, breakdown.spikes and content mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: No stated interaction anywhere. breakdown.cooldowns held zero digits (defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues 0) and only paraphrased 'break the tether'.
audit.why: The decisive numbers: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank with a 675 tether; Azir's Shifting Sands is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s. Her root returns roughly twice as often as your only escape, and a completed root prevents the E dash entirely. Gathering Fire pulls her 40/38/36/34s Mantra forward on every damaging hit, so free poke accelerates the empowered root. Mantra-W heals her and extends the root, which is the anti-heal trigger flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 12s / 9s-5s / 22s-16s explicitly; Morellonomicon added to itemization and breakdown.mid for the Mantra-W heal.

audit.why: 46.05% over 1127 games; no elo split written anywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood/tradeBad were template prose with no reference to what Karma can actually do to a trade.
audit.why: Her whole answer to a step-up is the 675 tether; outside it she has only Inner Flame chip.
audit.corrected: Trade lines now key to the 675 tether range and the 12s window after it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all — defect 3 in the catalogue.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Focused Resolve at 12s; the one you must never spend for damage is your own E at 22s down to 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization had no anti-heal despite Mantra-W healing her through extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal names Focused Resolve sustain as the deciding factor in long trades.
audit.corrected: Morellonomicon written into report[8].t, breakdown.mid and breakdown.spikes.
sources: brief enemyKit W Mantra bonus text

notes: CHART: the two layers disagreed before this audit — content win[0..3]=Karma / win[4..6]=Azir (matching packet.levelChart) while full phases[0..4].side all read "Skill". I moved the full layer onto the content layer's verdict rather than the reverse, because the packet chart and the 46.05% win rate both support Karma-favoured early. No win[N] edit is proposed because win[N] already holds the target value; after this lands the two layers agree on all seven rows. Every side I moved has its why rewritten in the same proposal, and early ratings dropped 5/10 -> 4/10 to match. Left alone deliberately: diff (EVEN), diffRating 5.5/10, carryRating 6/10 and breakdown.difficulty — 46.05% is close enough to even that I had no kit grounds to move them, and moving diffRating alone would contradict breakdown.difficulty's own text. dontsFull[1].d already carries a real number (E at 19s, rank 3) so it was left. Naming: 'Soul Flare' is the correct name for Mantra-Q, so the old text was not wrong there, but at the levels in question she is poking with plain Inner Flame, which is what I wrote.
